subject: Request: Marketplace publish waiver & co-sell discount for Nova Health
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@novahealth.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Requesting marketplace listing concession for Nova Health procurement

Hi Vivek / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at Nova Health is excited about Redwood’s latency profile. Our procurement group reviewed the Marketplace offer and hit two issues we need your help with before we can publish it to our internal vendor list: 

1) Minimum invoice threshold: our finance policy requires a 12-month committed minimum for marketplace private offers; procurement cannot accept that level for a pilot. Can Redwood waive or lower the minimum for the first 6 months?
2) List price vs. approved vendor discount: to comply with our vendor approval flow we need an initial negotiated discount visible on the marketplace (20% off list) or a registered private offer.

I’ve attached a short scope doc that procurement asked us to include (attached). Happy to hop on a quick call to walk through. Could you confirm whether Redwood can provide a waiver + a private offer flow? We also may need an AWS co-sell registration to proceed.

Best,
Elena 
Elena Torres
Procurement Manager, Nova Health
[Attachment: nova_health_scope.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@novahealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-23T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Requesting marketplace listing concession for Nova Health procurement

Elena — thanks for the clear write-up and the scope doc. I looped in Marissa (who owns marketplace ops for this region) and Rishi from Deal Desk to evaluate an exception.

Short answer: we can support a temporary minimum-waiver and a private offer, but it needs Deal Desk approval + AWS co-sell registration so the listing can be paired with a private offer in the marketplace. I’ve attached our current Q3 ratecard for context.

Next steps I propose:
- Rishi: can you confirm whether we can waive the 12-month minimum down to a 6-month pilot and apply a 20% private-offer discount visible to Nova Health?
- Marissa: if Deal Desk approves, can your team create a private offer SKU and the marketplace listing draft?
- Elena: can you confirm the internal PO cadence (monthly vs. upfront) so we set billing terms correctly.

Thanks — I’ll keep this thread for the approvals so procurement has a single source.

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Commercial & Partnerships | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_ratecard_q3.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-24T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Requesting marketplace listing concession for Nova Health procurement

Rishi / Kimberly — forwarding Nova Health ask. Key asks: waive 12-month minimum to 6 months and enable a 20% private-offer discount. Nova is an enterprise pilot with potential expansion into their telehealth product; region: US West.

Why this matters:
- Likely $120k ARR if they expand after pilot; good co-sell potential with AWS (they already use EKS + GuardDuty).
- Short-term concession keeps the procurement process moving and increases chance of co-sell.

If Deal Desk needs a short justification I can supply customer TAM and reference architecture. We’re also ready to submit the AWS co-sell registration once we have approval. Can you review and respond with approvals/conditions?

- Marissa
Marissa Cole
Marketplace & GTM Partnerships

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-24T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Requesting marketplace listing concession for Nova Health procurement — Deal Desk response

Marissa / Vivek — reviewed. We can approve a temporary waiver to reduce the committed minimum term to a 6-month pilot and permit a one-time 20% private-offer discount with the following conditions:

1) Customer signs a private offer (DocuSign) that includes a pilot acceptance clause and a renewal pricing band.
2) Redwood obtains AWS co-sell registration and provides the co-sell justification PDF for AWS (attached).
3) Finance confirms net-new revenue accounting for the pilot (no credit against future committed discounts).

I attached the co-sell justification template filled with the customer highlights. Marissa, please proceed to create the private offer SKU (use the pilot SKUs, mark as single-customer private offer).

I’m marking this as a conditional approval — I will greenlight final publish once: doc signed (DocuSign link), AWS co-sell registration is in flight, and Finance confirms billing cadence.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Deal Desk Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: co-sell-justification.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@novahealth.com>, aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-25T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Approved (conditional) — private offer & 6-month pilot for Nova Health

Elena — good news. Deal Desk has provided conditional approval for the two concessions you asked for:

• 6-month committed minimum (waiver from 12 months)
• 20% off list applied to a single-customer private offer visible to Nova Health

Conditions to finalize publish:
- Sign the private-offer DocuSign we will send today (includes pilot acceptance clause and renewal band)
- Redwood to submit AWS co-sell registration (Marissa will do this within 24 hours)
- Finance to confirm billing cadence (monthly PO accepted for the pilot)

Marissa: please create the private offer SKU and share the draft marketplace listing + the DocuSign envelope.
Rishi: once DocuSign executes and AWS registration is in progress, please confirm final publish.

Elena, I’m copying aws-marketplace-ops so they’re aware of the expected private-offer launch. We’ll push the DocuSign link shortly.

Thanks — looking forward to getting Nova Health onboarded.

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Commercial & Partnerships | Redwood Inference
[Attachments referenced: redwood_ratecard_q3.xlsx, co-sell-justification.pdf]
